next_tickets.body: Question: do P10n no-tail q-template gains that survive peak-phase swaps and rising-edge ablations improve independent downstream same-particle timing? Traditional: freeze the P10n phase-binned empirical template and S02/S03 timing baselines. ML/NN: freeze the P10n winner and phase-stability gated ensemble without refitting. Metric: downstream sigma68/full RMS, >5 ns tail fraction, and too-good trigger carryover with run-block bootstrap CIs. Expected information gain: tests whether phase-stable q gains survive a physics timing consumer rather than only waveform reconstruction.
